description: List bounced email addresses (the bounce suppression list). Returns an array of { created, email, reason, status }. SendGrid: GET /v3/suppression/bounces.

email.description: Filter to a specific bounced email address.

end_time.description: End of the time range, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

offset.description: Number of bounces to skip (for pagination).

start_time.description: Start of the time range, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).
